visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary Cistern House work, Bel's petition, the three separated copies, a shutter loss, bounded comparison, remedy choice, and four institutionally distinct ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate anchors for the establishing space, routine work, petition affordances, chosen filing action, seated copies, pivotal shutter loss, preservation affordances, chosen preservation action, comparison, remedy choice, and each ending family. visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base prompt restates visible Cistern House geometry, materials, lighting, bodies, tools, and records for a general image model. Branch prompts describe additive visible deltas. Character refs are assembled only for people visible in that frame; continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: high-fantasy civic storybook illustration in textured gouache and fine ink, permanent-twilight blue shadows, warm mineral steam, ash-grey stone, worn iron and cloth, expressive restrained faces, legible tools and records, humane dry wit under material danger, cinematic composition built for interactive-fiction replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each prompt from the global_style_cue, one complete scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters visible in that scene, and every triggered state or global branch modifier. Keep visual_continuity_notes out of the generated prompt.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view from the outer doorway into a compact stone Cistern House in a high-fantasy twilight settlement. A steaming live east basin fills the left half; a drained west inspection basin slopes down on the right toward an iron grate and a short stair ending at a black pressure door. A broad waist-high stone lip divides the basins. Iron screens, pottery ash buckets, three shallow water bowls, wall-mounted ration boards, a service board with three pale shutter marks, drain wheels, and damp tools make the room visibly functional. Warm mist beads on dark roof beams. Rough repair cloths hang from the western beam and two textured memorial cloths hang from the eastern beam. Bel Orra, a compact brown-skinned adult with close-cropped black hair, patched ochre wool coat, water yoke, and cracked work gloves, enters carrying three sample bowls.

visible_characters.default_stance: entering from the outer doorway with a water yoke and three bowls

visual_continuity_notes: Camera faces inward from the outer doorway. The east basin is left, west basin right, dividing lip center, service board on the back wall, and pressure-door stair below the west grate.
Memorial and repair cloths remain on separate beams and are visibly distinguished by texture because mineral mist has faded their colors.
